name: A05_clip
prompt: 2D animated documentary scene, clean cel shading, bold outlines, flat muted earthy colors, consistent style in every frame. Real-time speed. Quiet, uneasy stillness: the man sitting against the oak does not move at all, his head stays bowed and his eyes stay closed, his hands lie limp. Around him the scene is alive: patches of dappled sunlight and leaf shadows drift slowly across his shirt and the ground as the oak branches sway in a light breeze, a few dry leaves tumble across the dirt, the golden grass ripples, and the creek behind him flows and glints in the sun. The camera pushes in very slowly toward him.
